theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) tailored for Linear-style precision
theme_and_archetype.emotional_tone: Trust, clarity, and elite operational focus.

rules: Headings must use Manrope with negative letter spacing (tracking-tight) to evoke the crispness of SaaS platforms like Linear.
Data tables, tooltips, and file metadata should use IBM Plex Sans for maximum legibility of dense information.
Code blocks, file formats (CSV, JSON), and numeric KPIs should use JetBrains Mono.
The UI should feel mostly monochromatic (indigo-tinted greys) to let the semantic colors (Red/Yellow/Green) instantly highlight data quality alerts.
Avoid muddy greys; all neutral tones have a slight blue/indigo hue.
Gradients are strictly prohibited for backgrounds. Use solid colors with 1px borders.
Use strict, dense bento grid layouts for the dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6.
Sidebar width should be fixed at 260px on desktop.
Containers must have internal padding of at least p-6 to avoid data feeling claustrophobic.
All card corners should have rounded-lg or rounded-xl (not fully pill-shaped).
Never center dashboard content; left-align everything for scannability.

cards.style: Flat background, sharp 1px border. No drop shadows. Use border-[#1E293B] (dark mode) and border-[#E4E4E7] (light mode).
cards.hover: Subtle background shift (bg-[#171F32]) and border brighten, rather than floating animations.

upload_dropzone.style: Large interactive area. border-2 border-dashed border-[#1E293B]. When dragged over, the border shifts to border-indigo-500 and the background gets a subtle indigo tint (bg-[#4F46E5]/10).
upload_dropzone.typography: Include a massive, clear call-to-action in Manrope, e.g., 'Drop your dataset here (CSV, JSON, Parquet)'.

progress_bar.style: Height: 4px. Background: bg-indigo-500. Add an animated generic shine or glow using Framer Motion to simulate deep data processing.

buttons.primary: bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-semibold rounded-md transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#1E293B] hover:border-indigo-500 text-primary transition-colors

alerts.style: Traffic light icons (Phosphor) aligned horizontally. Green (Clean), Yellow (Missing values), Red (Critical duplicates/outliers). Use subtle background tints for the alert boxes (e.g., bg-red-500/10).

recharts.style: Colors must match the semantic or brand palette. No default Recharts colors. Remove chart background grid lines or make them extremely faint (strokeOpacity={0.1}). Tooltips must use the customized card style (dark background, sharp borders).

rules: Fast, snappy transitions. transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for hover states.
Collapsible sections (Accordions) should slide smoothly using Framer Motion.
The dashboard should reveal widgets with a staggered entrance animation (framer-motion delay) upon completing the data analysis.
No bounce or elastic easing; use linear or ease-out for a technical feel.

icons_and_assets.icon_style: weight='regular' for standard icons, weight='fill' for active sidebar states or colored alerts.

user_avatar.description: Professional avatar for the Google Auth user profile display.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use the @phosphor-icons/react library for all iconography. Use the 'fill' weight for traffic light alerts.
Implement the layout with a fixed Sidebar (Navigation) and a main scrollable content area.
Use Shadcn UI extensively but heavily override the default Vercel aesthetic. Remove shadows and enforce the 1px sharp border style.
The File Upload component must support Drag & Drop natively and transition gracefully into the 'Analyzing' state with a progress bar, then reveal the Dashboard.
For Recharts, ensure the stroke and fill colors are dynamically reading from Tailwind config or explicitly set to our indigo, green, yellow, and red palette.
Ensure all data tables (missing data, duplicates) are dense, with no unnecessary padding, simulating an advanced terminal or control room.
Implement light and dark mode toggling using next-themes or equivalent, defaulting to dark mode.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='upload-dropzone', data-testid='export-pdf-button').
